title: Workflow Event v1
description: Canonical evaluation event for agent workflow observability. Covers tool calls, state changes, refusals, and artifact emission. Designed for append-only JSONL storage and derived dataset compilation.

parent_session_id.description: Parent session when this is a delegated task session.

sequence.description: Monotonic event sequence within the session.

event_hash.description: SHA256 of the canonical JSON event (excluding this field).

agent_profile.description: Agent profile name active when the event was emitted.

provider.description: LLM provider in use (e.g. anthropic, openai, deepseek).

thinking_enabled.description: Whether extended thinking / chain-of-thought was active.

thinking_type.description: Thinking variant if applicable (e.g. extended, reasoning_effort).

tool_input_sha256.description: SHA256 of the canonical tool input JSON.

tool_output_sha256.description: SHA256 of the complete tool output text.

determinism_class.description: Classification of output determinism for this tool call.

mutation_class.description: Classification of mutation behavior (none, files, git, etc.).

decision.description: Permission decision made for the tool call.

latency_ms.description: Tool call wall-clock latency in milliseconds.

input_bytes.description: Byte size of the tool input.

output_bytes.description: Byte size of the tool output.

warnings.description: Non-fatal warnings emitted during the operation.

repo_state_sha256.description: SHA256 of the full GitStateArtifact for the repository at event time.

dirty_file_count.description: Number of dirty files in the working tree at mission start.

relative_path_hash.description: Salted SHA256 of the repository-relative file path.

file_bytes_sha256.description: SHA256 of file bytes at mission start.

blob_before_sha256.description: SHA256 of file bytes at mission start (alias for file_bytes_sha256, null for untracked).

dirty_file_snapshot.description: Full dirty file snapshot from DirtyFileGuard at mission start. Paths are hashed for privacy.

path_hash.description: Salted SHA256 of the file path read.

tool_name.description: Tool used to read (read_file, grep, git_show, etc.).

tool_call_id.description: Tool call that performed the read.

files_read.description: Files read during the session. Paths are hashed for privacy.

path_hash.description: Salted SHA256 of the file path changed.

before_sha256.description: SHA256 of file bytes before mutation.

after_sha256.description: SHA256 of file bytes after mutation.

expected_before_sha256.description: expected_before_sha256 provided by the agent, if any.

was_protected.description: True if the file was dirty at mission start.

files_changed.description: Files created or modified during the session.

path_hash.description: Salted SHA256 of the path involved, if file-specific.

refusal.description: Details when a write or mutation was refused by the guard.

command_hash.description: SHA256 of the command string executed.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock duration of the test run.

tool_call_id.description: Tool call that triggered the test run.

tests_run.description: Test runs executed during the session.

human_followup.description: True if the event represents or immediately follows a human interaction (question asked, input provided).

human_interaction_kind.description: Kind of human interaction, if applicable.

task_id.description: Delegation task identifier when this session is a child task.

task_graph.description: Fleet/delegate task graph metadata for this session.

child_profiles.description: Agent profiles used by child tasks.

path_scopes.description: Path scopes assigned to child tasks.

artifact_kind.description: Kind of artifact emitted, if this is an artifact event.

artifact_record_sha256.description: SHA256 of the full artifact envelope.

receipt_candidate.description: Whether this event is a receipt candidate for the Merkle chain.
